name: LPL 2027
overview: LPL's confirmed 2027 annual regional competition, run across Stage 1, Stage 2, Stage 3 (separated by the global July competitive break), and a Championship Stage. No team placements or champions are confirmed. The LPL regional field is standardized to 8 teams for 2027; participating franchises are tracked in the pre-Worlds 2026 real-world reference scene as Kairos Universe fictional 2027 regional-membership status, not as Kairos Universe internal canon teams, and are not listed in participantTeamIds here.
